title: 第11章 添衣御寒
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

穿越倒计时：4天。

谭筝中的是大奖，得去省彩中心兑换。

经过一系列手续，并扣除税款后，余下的奖金被打入账户，她的可支配资金上涨到了二百八十万。

衣食住行是人类生存的基本需求，保障人身温饱与日常活动，缺一不可。

系统只说穿越到古代灾年，具体是什么灾年并没有说明，万一是暴雪灾年，没有御寒的衣物，那可就死定了。

所以一出省彩中心，谭筝就直奔当地最大的服装批发市场。

市场内里四通八达，一眼望不到头。

两侧档口挨挨挤挤，各式衣物层层叠叠挂满门头、堆在货架上，琳琅满目。

谭筝没去楼上那些小档口，而是坐着电梯，径直去了负一楼。

这是整个服装批发市场里最大的档口，除了日常的衣物，还有这些年兴起的汉服、洛丽塔，以及鞋靴、帽子围巾之类的搭配单品，可谓是一应俱全。

许是因为谭筝年轻，再加上一副不太熟悉的样子，档口老板有些不耐烦。

“诶，小妹，这里只批发，不零售的哈，可以混批，每款最少拿五件，凑一百件起批，少于这个数量，就不要进来了。”

她自认为讲得够清楚了，等下要是还问能不能单买，可别怪她翻脸。

“好，我知道了。”

谭筝不咸不淡地应了一句，率先朝内衣区走去，挨个试了一下手感，选出最舒服的几款。

这玩意不比其他衣服，更换的频率要高不少，所以得多买些。

“老板，这裤衩子一口气要八百条，批发价多少一条？”

正在吃麻辣烫的老板加快嗦粉的速度，有些含糊地应了一声：“大包装五元一条，单独包装五块三一条。”

“要单独包装的。”

“行。”

“我再看看别的，你先把货号记上，待会一块算。”

谭筝又扭头看上了袜子。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Countdown to time travel: 4 days.

Tan Zheng won a grand prize and had to go to the Provincial Lottery Center to redeem it.

After a series of procedures and tax deductions, the remaining bonus was credited into the account, and her disposable funds rose to 2.8 million.

Food, clothing, housing and transportation are the basic needs for human survival. They are indispensable to ensure food, clothing and daily activities.

The system only said that it had traveled to an ancient disaster year, but it did not specify what disaster year it was. If it was a snowstorm year and there was no clothing to keep out the cold, it would be doomed.

So as soon as she left the Provincial Lottery Center, Tan Zheng went straight to the largest local clothing wholesale market.

The market extends in all directions, and it's endless as far as the eye can see.

The stalls on both sides are crowded together, and all kinds of clothes are hung in layers on top of the door and piled on the shelves, a dazzling array.

Tan Zheng did not go to the small stalls upstairs, but took the elevator and went straight to the first floor.

This is the largest stall in the entire clothing wholesale market. In addition to daily clothing, there are also Hanfu, Lolita, and matching items such as shoes, hats and scarves that have emerged in recent years.

Perhaps because Tan Zheng was young and looked unfamiliar, the stall owner was a little impatient.

"Hey, little sister, we only sell wholesale here, not retail. You can mix batches. At least five pieces of each style, and the minimum batch is 100 pieces. If the quantity is less than this, don't come in."

She thinks she has made it clear enough. If she asks if she can buy it separately later, don't blame her for falling out.

"Okay, I get it."

Tan Zheng responded calmly, and took the lead to walk towards the underwear area, trying out the feel of each one and choosing the most comfortable ones.

This item is no different than other clothes and needs to be replaced much more frequently, so buy more.

"Boss, these pants cost 800 pairs at a time. How much is the wholesale price?"

The boss, who was eating Malatang, sped up the noodles and responded vaguely: "The big package costs five yuan a piece, and the individual packaging costs five yuan and thirty a piece."

"It needs to be packaged individually."

"Okay."

"I'll look at the others. You write down the item number first and we'll do the math together later."

Tan Zheng turned her head and looked at the socks again.
